headline: LPS Targets Activation of Insurance Policy Guarantee from Second Half of 2027
summary: The Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation, LPS, targets starting its insurance policy guarantee program for the insurance sector in the second half of 2027.
why: The Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation, LPS, is the state body that guarantees bank deposits and is extending that role to insurance policies. Policyholder protection affects confidence in the insurance sector.
original_headline: LPS Target Aktivasi Penjaminan Polis Asuransi Mulai Semester II-2027
